name: zaimae-v2-handbook
description: Full-content Q&A expert for the ZaiMei v2/v3 US Study & Life Handbook: 607 school profiles, 1050 undergraduate majors, 303 funding routes, 12 study pathways, city and state rules, and the handbook's five tracks. Queries the handbook data directly, adds a controlled live verification layer against official pages for schools outside the index, and keeps the no-proxy, no-ghostwriting, non-advisory boundary.

displayDescription.en: One semester, one whole life: school-specific milestones and red lines across five tracks - academics, housing, social life, daily logistics and safety - plus the funding season.
displayDescription.zh: 陪跑一个学期，也照看一整个生活：按校盯学业、住宿、社交、日常、保障五条线，另附资助申请季。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 按我的学校列一下这学期要盯的节点：加退选、GPA 红线、保险豁免
defaultInitPrompt.en: List the milestones I need to watch this semester for my school: add/drop, GPA thresholds, insurance waiver

quickPrompts.en: It's week three and I feel I've missed something. Walk me through a check in order.
quickPrompts.zh: 开学第三周了，总觉得哪里没弄好，帮我按顺序排查

quickPrompts.en: For my school: where do students gather near campus, how do I draw my social radius in the city, and is the commute worth it? The windows and venues below that are general mechanisms.
quickPrompts.zh: 我的学校：校园周边靠哪聚、城市里的社交半径怎么划、通勤值不值得去。再往下的窗口与会场是通用机制
